themes.title: Ownership
themes.question: What does it mean to own?
themes.description: We create, exchange, use and depend on things every day. But where does access end and ownership begin? Who decides what belongs to us, and what happens when the rules change?

themes.title: Permanence
themes.question: What should last?
themes.description: Objects, memories, platforms and ideas all change or disappear. What do we lose when they don't last? What should be preserved, repaired or passed on, and what are we willing to let go?

themes.title: Energy
themes.question: What powers possibility?
themes.description: Energy moves through the systems we depend on, from natural resources and infrastructure to human effort and creative drive. Who has access to it? How is it distributed, and what does it make possible?

themes.title: Peers
themes.question: How do we connect?
themes.description: Connection depends on more than being online. How do trust, privacy and shared purpose shape the ways we communicate, organise and support one another? What becomes possible when people can connect directly, with no one in the middle?
